tree: How can a business manage bookings across multiple staff members?
Booking management software keeps every booking for every staff member in one list, with its status, payment and change history, so nothing gets lost between people.
Bookings, deposits and cancellations are tracked in different places by different people.
One workspace shows each booking’s status, payment and full history.
Booking management software tracks every booking from start to finish.
See customer information, service details, payment status, staff assignment, notes and the complete history — all in one place.
Track every booking through its lifecycle with clear status updates and quick actions to keep operations running smoothly.

Set up confirmation policies, cancellation windows, deposits, buffer times and more.
Automatically confirm new bookings or require manual approval.
Set how far in advance customers can cancel or reschedule.
